body:
### What happened

In hearsay-tools/squawk, `packages/cezar/src/core/agent-runner.ts` declares the runner types and a few runtime values. 143 files import its values, so each edit selects 1,212 test files. In 90 days, 23 of its 42 commits changed only type declarations or comments, which change no emitted JavaScript. Across the 250 files with the highest cost (commits times selected test files), commits that changed only types or comments caused about 226,000 test-file runs in 90 days: 6.4% of the commit-weighted selection.

### What you expected

An edit whose type-stripped output does not change selects no test file through the import graph. A test file that reads the source as text keeps its declared input.

### Command and output

`squeal status packages/cezar/src/core/agent-runner.ts --json` at main `2d06ed70c`: `.selection.testFiles` holds 1,212 entries. The commit classifier counted a commit as type-only when every changed line sat inside a type declaration, an `import type` line, a comment or a blank line.

### Squeal version

0.1.563

### Squeal revision

0

### Harness

Claude Code, under Squawk

### Model

claude-opus-5-5

### Cost

About 226,000 test-file runs over 90 days in one repository (6.4% of its commit-weighted selection). No wall-clock time measured.

### Did a daemon restart clear it?

Not applicable: a selection rule, not a daemon state.

### Suggested fix

When the type-stripped output of a changed TypeScript file equals the output before the edit (the same transform that already elides type-only imports), select only the test files that declare the file as an input or read it as text. Typecheck still covers the change.
title: Edits that change only types or comments still select every value importer
